blocker_1_mitbih_class_descriptions.name: MIT-BIH Class N Description
blocker_1_mitbih_class_descriptions.finding: In this project, class 0 consists exclusively of Normal beats (annotated symbol 'N'). There are exactly zero bundle branch block annotations ('L', 'R', or 'B') in the extracted 300-segment dataset. Describing class N as 'Normal / bundle branch block beats' is factually incorrect.
blocker_1_mitbih_class_descriptions.corrected_text: MIT-BIH annotation class N (Normal beats, class 0)

blocker_2_vqc_optimizer.name: VQC Optimizer Verification
blocker_2_vqc_optimizer.finding: The true optimizer is SciPy COBYLA (opt.minimize(method='COBYLA', options={'maxiter': 50, 'rhobeg': 0.1, 'tol': 1e-4})). Nelder-Mead was never executed in the codebase. All 10 training runs and frozen candidate fold_1_seed_303 used COBYLA.
blocker_2_vqc_optimizer.corrected_text: SciPy COBYLA (Constrained Optimization BY Linear Approximation)

blocker_3_logistic_regression_reconcilia.name: Logistic Regression Held-Out Metrics Reconciliation
blocker_3_logistic_regression_reconcilia.finding: The 71.00% result in README.md is unbacked by any saved JSON, CSV, or script output in the repository. Clean replication on all N=200 training beats confirms 92.00% accuracy.
blocker_3_logistic_regression_reconcilia.recommendation: Remove the unsupported 71.00% comparison from README.md, or replace it with the verified 92.00% baseline with honest scientific disclosure that the linear baseline outperforms the 6Q VQC in accuracy (92% vs 76%/77%).
